Bootstrap Reviewer Skills are valid migration inputs but need convergence for required step/complexity/scope-drift reporting, review-chain and literal/invariant discipline, concise handoff, and explicit no-product-self-hosting parity. The temporary Run-surface bridge can be retired after this formal/bootstrap Reviewer coverage lands. No Core, lifecycle, dependency or per-Change architecture mutation is required.
